incomplete: The check was incomplete — Steam was not reachable or gave an unclear answer. That is a statement about the check, not about the mods. Cleanup is therefore locked.

recheck.title: Ask Steam again now
removed.explain: Joining players can no longer download them and get stuck while joining. Whoever still has them in the local cache keeps getting in — which is why this is often only noticed when someone new wants to join.
